submission.justification:
Radiator-R3 at 4 cm thickness is recommended for the RICH detector based on the following analysis:

**Transparency Requirements:** Only two radiators (R1 and R3) meet the hard requirement of ≤10% transparency loss after 10-year-equivalent humidity aging. R2 exhibits 40% transparency loss and is eliminated from consideration.

**Optimal Configuration:** Among the viable candidates, R3 at 4 cm thickness was identified as the optimal configuration. This thickness falls within the allowed 1-6 cm range.

**Expected Performance:** R3 is expected to provide better pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c compared to R1 due to its higher refractive index. A higher refractive index produces a larger Cherenkov angle difference between pions and kaons, which directly translates to improved particle identification capability.

**Reliability:** With only 6% transparency loss after aging, R3 provides a comfortable margin below the 10% limit, ensuring long-term detector performance stability over the entire operational period without requiring radiator replacement.

This recommendation optimizes the primary goal of achieving the best possible pion/kaon separation while satisfying all hard constraints on transparency degradation and thickness range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c
requirements.evidence: R3 with its higher refractive index is expected to provide superior separation compared to R1. The optimal thickness of 4 cm maximizes this performance.

requirements.requirement: Radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 is one of the three candidates evaluated (R1, R2, R3).

requirements.requirement: Pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma
requirements.evidence: R3 at 4 cm is expected to exceed the 3.5 sigma requirement based on its optimal refractive index properties and thickness optimization.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing must not exceed 10%
requirements.evidence: R3 shows only 6% transparency loss after aging test, well below the 10% threshold.
Recommended thickness of 4 cm falls within the specified 1-6 cm range.
